mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario_id, binding_type, target_ref, target_id, target_type, remark, create_time FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_asset_binding WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO #{schema}.ecos_scenario_asset_binding (id, scenario_id, binding_type, target_ref, target_id, target_type, remark, is_island, island_reason, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_deleted, version_no, domain) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.scenarioId}, #{row.bindingType}, #{row.targetRef}, #{row.targetId}, #{row.targetType}, #{row.remark}, FALSE, NULL, #{row.createBy}, NOW(), #{row.updateBy}, NOW(), 0, 0, #{row.domain})
mapper.update: UPDATE #{schema}.ecos_scenario_asset_binding SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE #{schema}.ecos_scenario_asset_binding SET is_island = #{isIsland}, island_reason = #{islandReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{bindingId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE #{schema}.ecos_scenario_asset_binding SET is_island = FALSE, island_reason = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND is_deleted = 0
